name: indexscout
description: Read-only Google Search Console investigations for agents.
long_description: IndexScout compares periods, diagnoses traffic changes, ranks opportunities on existing pages, classifies cannibalization, and audits indexing using read-only Search Console access. Run `indexscout auth login` once in a terminal before use.

tools.name: gsc_capabilities
tools.description: Explain what IndexScout can do, whether it is authenticated, and which properties it may use.

tools.name: gsc_list_properties
tools.description: List Search Console properties with exact identifiers, permission level, and local-policy status.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Low-level Search Analytics rows with explicit dates, dimensions, filters, and pagination.

tools.name: gsc_site_snapshot
tools.description: Answer "How is this property doing?" Current vs previous equal-length period.

tools.name: gsc_diagnose_change
tools.description: Answer "Why did clicks or impressions change?" by decomposing the change, without claiming cause.

tools.name: gsc_find_opportunities
tools.description: Answer "What should I work on?" with ranked, evidence-backed opportunities on existing pages.

tools.name: gsc_page_analysis
tools.description: Answer "What is happening with this page?" for one exact URL.

tools.name: gsc_query_analysis
tools.description: Answer "How do we perform for this search?" for one exact query.

tools.name: gsc_find_cannibalization
tools.description: Find queries that Google shows for more than one page, and classify each split.

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: Show Google's index status for one URL: verdict, coverage, last crawl, canonicals, robots.txt, indexing and fetch state, referring URLs, and sitemaps.

tools.name: gsc_indexing_audit
tools.description: Inspect a bounded set of URLs concurrently and group them by indexing problem.

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List submitted sitemaps with submission and download dates, pending state, errors, warnings, and content counts. Read-only: IndexScout never submits or deletes sitemaps.

allowed_properties.title: Allowed properties
allowed_properties.description: Optional comma-separated exact GSC property identifiers, e.g. sc-domain:example.com. Empty allows all accessible properties.

client_secrets.title: OAuth client JSON
client_secrets.description: Optional path to your Desktop OAuth client file. Default: the IndexScout config directory.
